task.title: Claim due one-shot schedules
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/793 with a durable due-only reservation that grants no dispatch authority.
acceptance_criteria: Claim only an existing pending schedule due at or before the caller cutoff and preserve the claim through reopen.
Exclude claimed schedules from due discovery and reject future schedules with typed due evidence.
Resolve claim-claim and claim-cancel races to one persisted terminal winner.
Reject malformed payloads and impossible claim histories without partial projection.

attempts.summary: Established RED claim eligibility and race coverage.
attempts.diagnostic: The focused tests failed because claim, claimed status, NotDue, and AlreadyClaimed did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added cutoff, reopen, due-list exclusion, terminal precedence, malformed-history, claim-claim, and claim-cancel tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Treating due discovery as authority would permit duplicate selection, but adding a lease would require missing worker and expiry policy.
attempts.patch: Added one empty claimed event, explicit caller cutoff validation, status-first terminal rejection, and authoritative conflict reload.

attempts.summary: Fixed the substantive documentation mismatch and verified exact-head behavior.
attempts.diagnostic: Hosted review found ADR text that still described only created and cancelled histories after claimed history became valid.
attempts.patch: Aligned ADR replay rules, documented terminal-error precedence over NotDue, retained refactor nits outside feature scope, and reran focused and full verification.

outcome.summary: Due one-shot intent can now be durably reserved exactly once while clock input, recovery, dispatch, and execution remain caller-owned.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test schedule_store

lessons: Due discovery is observability; a separate durable transition must reserve work.
Terminal lifecycle errors should take precedence over due-time evaluation so caller intent is not misclassified.
Claiming without automatic expiry makes crash recovery limitations explicit rather than inventing lease policy.
When lifecycle behavior expands, update earlier authoritative replay prose instead of only appending later documentation.
